Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Washington, DC, City Council passes bill prohibiting insurance companies from denying coverage to "high risk" persons or those with HTLVIII antibody 2. Providence, Rhode Island, equal rights amendment killed by constitutional conventional committee COMMERCIAL: First Hand gay magazine 3. Senatorial candidate Phil Reed discusses a state gay rights bill COMMERCIAL: Urban General Warehouse Sale 4. Event announcement 5. Andy Humm discusses relationships breaking up 6. Anchorage, Alaska, Mayor opposes amendment of equal rights ordinance to include homosexuals COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 7. Colorado, senate and house committees fail to vote on AIDS quarantine bill 8. US Senate raises AIDS research budget 9. AIDS becomes leading killer of men aged 30-44 and women aged 25-29 in New York City 10. Soldier is court-martialed after refusing to take a required HTLVIII antibody test 11. Two female high-schoolers allowed to attend prom together after a court order COMMERCIAL: Arcos Blancos resort, Puerto Rico 12. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: New York City Gay Men's Chorus 13. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Raymond Jacobs, discussing GMHC's erotic safer-sex movie "Chance of a Lifetime" and safer-sex workshops 14. Closing Credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation Interview with Kevin Glines, playwright and co-founder of non-profit gay arts organization The Glines COMMERCIAL: Body-mate exercise equipment Interview with Stephen Holt, playwright, discusses his play "The Casting of Kevin Christian," reading from play COMMERCIAL: Water Front Airways
